ala.text: Grixis was once connected to the other shards and flush with life, but when it separated from Alara it lost access to its white and green mana.

Demons, witches and necromancers gained power while angels went extinct, and after the corruption of Sedris, necromancer barons and demon lords conquered more of the lands of the living and the plane became known as Grixis.
The result was a hellish world ruled by undeath and tormented by demons, where few living humans were left, and Nicol Bolas came to hold it firmly under his sway.

con.text: In Conflux, Grixis collides with the rest of Alara, and its demons and undead swarm across the borders to feed on the life essence of the neighboring shards.
Nicol Bolas orders his general Malfegor to assemble an army of necromancers and undead and destroy the remaining human holdouts on Grixis, and the Conflux floods the shard with life energies.
Grixis terrain bursts through Jund's lava, the dead catch the scent of life and follow it into Jund, and goblins who went to sleep in Jund awaken in Grixis facing zombies.

arb.text: In Alara Reborn, Grixis presses against Esper at their frontiers, where thousands die, and its undead assault a Bant stronghold.
The Riftclan Tol Breot is blasted from Jund into Grixis, where Thraximundar cuts down its chieftain Breot and the undead engulf the clan.

Even so, a knight finds Zarratha's front lines made of his dead clanmates and destroys the lich with dragonfire, and descendants of Vithia hope to rebuild their fallen kingdom as green and white mana trickles back.

mh3.text: Grixis is where Meren trained, and she reanimates a great dragon, Skaal Kesh.
